name: theme
label: Theme
description: The theme object to be applied to the editor.

name: content
label: Content

uid.description: Unique identifier that can be used to force Updated Properties to fire when content is same

isMandatory.description: Indicates if the section is mandatory

description: The HTML content to be loaded into the editor.

name: updatedContent
label: Update Content

id.description: The ID of the component to update

content.description: The new HTML content to replace/update

replace.description: If true, replaces the entire component; if false or omitted, only updates inner components

loading.description: If true, shows a loading state for the component; when loading is true, content will be replaced with a loader

loaderHeading.description: The heading to display in the loader when loading is true

description: Array of content updates to be applied to specific components in the editor.

name: selectContent
label: Select Content
description: The selector path to the block that should be selected

name: lastValidation
label: Last Validation Timestamp
description: The last timestamp form got validation error

name: assets
label: Assets
description: Array of asset objects which drive the asset library as well as internal file assets.

name: lastSaved
label: Last Saved
description: Controls the management and saving of internal JS and CSS asset files.

name: showRightPanel
label: Show Right Panel
description: Controls if the right panel should be open by default

name: restrictedDrop
label: Restrict Drop
description: Restricts blocks being droppable on the body, should be used with defaultContent or content

name: showSection
label: Show Section
description: When enabled, displays each HTML content item in its own section with a heading. Automatically set to true when multiple content items are present.

name: readonly
label: Read Only
description: Controls if the content editor is in read-only mode

name: showToolbarSlot
label: Show Toolbar Slot
description: Controls whether to display the toolbar slot for custom components

name: enableContentUpdates
label: Enable Content Updates
description: Controls whether to dispatch the CONTENT_UPDATED action.

name: contentTableName
label: Content table name
description: The table name that will be set as the reference for the uploaded attachments

name: contentSysId
label: Content sys id
description: The content record ID that will be set as the reference for the uploaded attachments

name: tinymceConfig
label: TinyMCE Configuration
description: TinyMCE configuration for text fields in the editor

name: linkList
label: Link List
description: List of attachment links to populate the TinyMCE Link List dropdown. Each item maps an attachment filename to its sys_attachment URL. When non-empty, the Link List section appears in the Insert/Edit Link dialog.

name: language
label: Language
description: Session/UI language code (e.g. 'ja', 'fr', 'zh_CN') used to localize the TinyMCE editor toolbar, menus, and dialogs. When not provided, TinyMCE defaults to English regardless of the session language.
